title: PMOVES standard branch protection
description: Canonical branch-protection profile schema for the PMOVES org. Consumed by `pmoves/tools/branch_protection.py` to apply + audit + drift-check across the 8+ PMOVES forks. Each profile is a per-repo declaration of: required status checks, required PR review policy, branch-protection ruleset shape, and optional bypass actors. The shape mirrors the GitHub REST API: branches/{branch}/protection + rulesets endpoints, so a profile maps 1:1 to API calls. The schema is strict on the profile keys (additionalProperties: false) so an unintended typo fails the validator before the tool hits the network.

monorepo.description: The PMOVES.AI monorepo profile. 4 required status checks from the PMOVES GitHub App, 1 reviewer with code-owner enforcement, linear history + signed commits + conversation resolution. Admins are NOT enforced (operator preauthorized --admin override for hot lanes). The [main] ruleset layers on top of classic protection with explicit bypass actors for the PMOVES GitHub App + the Copilot integration.

fork.description: The PMOVES fork profile (used for PMOVES-hermes-agent, PMOVES-pinokio, and any future PMOVES-* fork). The per-repo required status checks are declared in the fork's own config — this profile is the SHAPE. A fork consumer passes its own required status checks + this profile as the layered structure. Linear history is required (no merge commits); signatures are NOT required (forks often receive upstream commits that aren't signed by the fork's contributors); conversation resolution is required; admins are NOT enforced (the operator preauthorized --admin for hot lanes). No bypass actors (forks have no Copilot integration, no PMOVES GitHub App).
